title: Ruleset manifest (ruleset.json)
description: The top-level manifest of a rulesets/<id>/ directory: identity, format version, and the ruleset's declared attribute/defense/resource vocabulary. See internal/rules/load.go for the authoritative loader; this document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

format_version.description: Only "2" is accepted by this loader version — format v1 is retired (Task 4, spec 2026-07-25-format-v2-composition-design.md §3/§9: clean break, no external v1 authors). See atom.schema.json for the atoms/*.json this format version composes abilities from.

attributes.description: Names usable as '@'-refs in expressions (e.g. attack rolls, damage, default_max_expr). Each name must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ — the expression grammar's IDENT charset (internal/rules/expr.go); NOT the kebab-case used for ability/condition ids, since a hyphenated name would lex as subtraction rather than one identifier (e.g. "brawn-2" -> "brawn" - 2).

defenses.description: Names an ability's attack.vs may target. Constrained to the same ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ charset as attributes/resources for consistency, even though defense names are currently only ever used as plain string field values (attack.vs), never lexed inside an expression.

name.description: Also usable as a '#'-ref in expressions — must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (the expression grammar's IDENT charset), not kebab-case.

default_max_expr.description: Optional expression (see internal/rules/expr.go grammar). Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: this expression is evaluated without recording its rolls, so a die here would draw from the Roller unrecorded.

when.description: Expression; non-zero result means the threshold is met. Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: a threshold 'when' is evaluated without recording its rolls, which would break the rolled-once-recorded-forever testimony contract (spec §2 decision 3).

apply_condition.description: A condition id declared under conditions/.
